answer: In PoA, each interaction updates a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, lacks trusted transitive support, and cannot pass consensus; anomalous signal clusters, even amid karst-like fragmentation or sable identities, remain isolated until independently endorsed over time.
